newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile cobalt sale slated for Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile cobalt sale slated for Sept 23.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile said it scheduled its final cobalt sale for Sept 23.
Stockpile plans to sell 500,000 lbs of cobalt by sealed bid.
The final solicitation is subject to the terms of the previous solicitation of Aug 6, except for ammendments to the removal schedule.

Stockpile didn't change its assaying provision, which prompted a complaint from Minor Metals Inc. Stockpile brings in the Minor Metals Trade Association to sample 25 percent of the material. Minor Metals called for 100 percent sampling.
((Derek J. Caney, New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1646))
